title: MLLM-CTBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Continual Instruction Tuning of Multimodal LLMs with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Analysis
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (MLLM-CTBench) for evaluating multimodal reasoning in domains such as mathematics, science, medicine, and arts. It focuses on technical reasoning capabilities and does not evaluate religious, moral, or ethical belief systems.
